hook.en: Every account has two sides: debit on the left and credit on the right. A few simple rules tell us which side to use.
hook.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಖಾತೆಗೂ ಎರಡು ಬದಿಗಳಿವೆ: ಎಡಕ್ಕೆ ಡೆಬಿಟ್, ಬಲಕ್ಕೆ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್. ಯಾವ ಬದಿ ಬಳಸಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಕೆಲವು ಸರಳ ನಿಯಮಗಳು ಹೇಳುತ್ತವೆ.

objectives.en: Explain the meaning of an account, debit and credit
Apply the rules of debit and credit to the five types of accounts

narration.en: Every account has two sides: debit on the left and credit on the right. A few simple rules tell us which side to use.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಖಾತೆಗೂ ಎರಡು ಬದಿಗಳಿವೆ: ಎಡಕ್ಕೆ ಡೆಬಿಟ್, ಬಲಕ್ಕೆ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್. ಯಾವ ಬದಿ ಬಳಸಬೇಕು ಎಂದು ಕೆಲವು ಸರಳ ನಿಯಮಗಳು ಹೇಳುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: An account is a summarised record of all transactions relating to one item, such as cash, a person or an expense. It is drawn in a T shape: the left side is the debit (Dr) side and the right side is the credit (Cr) side. Debit and credit do not mean good or bad; they only show the side on which an amount is written.
body.kn: ಖಾತೆ ಒಂದು ವಿಷಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳ ಸಂಕ್ಷಿಪ್ತ ದಾಖಲೆ. ಎಡಭಾಗ ಡೆಬಿಟ್, ಬಲಭಾಗ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್.

narration.en: An account is a summarised record of all transactions relating to one item, such as cash, a person or an expense. It is drawn in a T shape: the left side is the debit (Dr) side and the right side is the credit (Cr) side. Debit and credit do not mean good or bad; they only show the side on which an amount is written.
narration.kn: ಖಾತೆ ಒಂದು ವಿಷಯಕ್ಕೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳ ಸಂಕ್ಷಿಪ್ತ ದಾಖಲೆ. ಎಡಭಾಗ ಡೆಬಿಟ್, ಬಲಭಾಗ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್.

body.en: Under the accounting equation approach: assets and expenses (including losses and drawings) increase on the debit side and decrease on the credit side. Liabilities, capital and revenues (including gains) increase on the credit side and decrease on the debit side.
body.kn: ಆಸ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ವೆಚ್ಚ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದರೆ ಡೆಬಿಟ್, ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾದರೆ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್. ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ, ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಮತ್ತು ಆದಾಯ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದರೆ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್, ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾದರೆ ಡೆಬಿಟ್.

narration.en: Under the accounting equation approach: assets and expenses (including losses and drawings) increase on the debit side and decrease on the credit side. Liabilities, capital and revenues (including gains) increase on the credit side and decrease on the debit side.
narration.kn: ಆಸ್ತಿ ಮತ್ತು ವೆಚ್ಚ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದರೆ ಡೆಬಿಟ್, ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾದರೆ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್. ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ, ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಮತ್ತು ಆದಾಯ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾದರೆ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್, ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾದರೆ ಡೆಬಿಟ್.

problem.en: State which account is debited and which is credited: (a) bought machinery for cash ₹50,000; (b) paid salary ₹12,000; (c) received interest ₹2,000; (d) took a bank loan ₹1,00,000.

answer.en: (a) Machinery Dr/Cash Cr (b) Salary Dr/Cash Cr (c) Cash Dr/Interest Cr (d) Cash Dr/Loan Cr

narration.en: Let us work this out step by step. State which account is debited and which is credited: (a) bought machinery for cash ₹50,000; (b) paid salary ₹12,000; (c) received interest ₹2,000; (d) took a bank loan ₹1,00,000.

body.en: Debits increase Expenses, Assets and Drawings; Credits increase Liabilities, Income and Capital.

narration.en: Debits increase Expenses, Assets and Drawings; Credits increase Liabilities, Income and Capital.
Team quiz. Each team discusses and gives one answer.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡವೂ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಲಿ.

points.en: Debit is the left side, credit the right side of an account.
Assets, expenses and drawings increase with a debit.
points.kn: ಆಸ್ತಿ, ವೆಚ್ಚ ಮತ್ತು ಸೆಳೆತ ಡೆಬಿಟ್‌ನಿಂದ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತವೆ.

points.en: Liabilities, capital and revenues increase with a credit.
points.kn: ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ, ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಮತ್ತು ಆದಾಯ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್‌ನಿಂದ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತವೆ.

homework.en: Classify ten accounts from your textbook into assets, liabilities, capital, revenues and expenses, and write the increase side of each.

narration.en: Recap. Debit is the left side, credit the right side of an account. Assets, expenses and drawings increase with a debit. Liabilities, capital and revenues increase with a credit.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಡೆಬಿಟ್ ಎಡಭಾಗ, ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಬಲಭಾಗ. ಆಸ್ತಿ, ವೆಚ್ಚ ಮತ್ತು ಸೆಳೆತ ಡೆಬಿಟ್‌ನಿಂದ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತವೆ. ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ, ಬಂಡವಾಳ ಮತ್ತು ಆದಾಯ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್‌ನಿಂದ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತವೆ.
